title: Climate Change 2023: Synthesis Report
summary: Foundational synthesis of climate change science, impacts, adaptation, and mitigation, with direct relevance for energy systems, freshwater stress, infrastructure vulnerability, and biospheric stability.
relevance: Core reference for climate as a systemic biospheric constraint and for climate-related interdependencies across the dataset.

title: Special Report on the Ocean and Cryosphere in a Changing Climate
summary: Major assessment of ocean warming, acidification, sea-level rise, cryosphere change, and cascading impacts on ecosystems, coastal systems, and climate regulation.
relevance: Primary source for the ocean–climate relationship and for the ocean’s role in habitability and biospheric buffering.

title: Global Assessment Report on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services
publisher: Intergovernmental Science-Policy Platform on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services
summary: Global reference on biodiversity decline, ecosystem degradation, ecosystem services, land-use pressures, and interactions between climate, water, soils, and living systems.
relevance: Foundational source for biodiversity, living systems, ecosystem resilience, and cross-domain ecological interdependence.

title: Status of the World's Soil Resources
publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
summary: Global assessment of soil degradation, fertility loss, erosion, salinization, contamination, and the ecological functions of soils in food systems and water regulation.
relevance: Core source for the soil constraint and for the role of soils in hydrology, fertility, and ecological continuity.

title: United Nations World Water Development Report 2024
summary: Global report on freshwater stress, water governance, allocation pressures, infrastructure dependence, and the vulnerability of societies and ecosystems to water disruption.
relevance: Key source for freshwater as a systemic constraint affecting agriculture, infrastructures, and living systems.

title: Water and Climate Change
summary: Reference page synthesising how climate change affects the hydrological cycle, water stress, floods, droughts, and water security.
relevance: Useful bridge source for the climate–freshwater interdependency and water vulnerability under warming.

title: World Energy Outlook 2024
summary: Global assessment of energy systems, fossil dependence, electricity demand, energy transitions, and the infrastructure implications of changing energy mixes.
relevance: Core source for the energy constraint and for energy’s entanglement with climate, infrastructure, and material systems.

title: Data Centres and Data Transmission Networks
summary: Reference on the electricity demand, infrastructure footprint, and material implications of data centres, networks, and digital systems.
relevance: Important source for linking AI-relevant information systems to energy demand, infrastructures, and material support.

title: Global Resources Outlook 2024
summary: Major assessment of global resource extraction, material use, environmental pressures, emissions, and the material basis of industrial and digital systems.
relevance: Core source for the matter constraint and for the physical grounding of infrastructure, energy, and information systems.

title: Minerals for Climate Action: The Mineral Intensity of the Clean Energy Transition
summary: Report on the critical mineral requirements of low-carbon technologies and the material intensity of the energy transition.
relevance: Useful source for the matter–energy relationship and the material cost of decarbonised energy systems.

title: Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework
summary: Global biodiversity framework focused on ecosystem integrity, restoration, species protection, freshwater systems, marine systems, and resilience.
relevance: Strong policy-science reference for biodiversity as a cross-cutting condition of biospheric resilience.

title: Our Future in the Anthropocene Biosphere
summary: High-level synthesis on biosphere stewardship, resilience, Earth-system interdependence, and the need to reconnect human systems with living planetary processes.
relevance: Important conceptual anchor for the AGI Biospheric framing and for the living-systems perspective across the dataset.

title: Planetary Boundaries: Guiding Human Development on a Changing Planet
summary: Foundational Earth-system framework identifying interacting planetary processes, ecological thresholds, and the systemic consequences of human pressure.
relevance: One of the strongest conceptual references for treating biospheric constraints as interdependent rather than isolated.

title: Earth for All: A Survival Guide for Humanity
authors: Dixon, Rockström, Gaffney, Randers, et al.
summary: Systems-oriented synthesis on ecological overshoot, social resilience, inequality, and long-term civilisational viability.
relevance: Secondary synthesis source useful for framing biospheric constraints within broader societal resilience questions.

title: Green Infrastructure
summary: Resource on the relationship between ecological infrastructures, biodiversity, water regulation, resilience, and human settlements.
relevance: Useful support for the infrastructure constraint when considered in relation to ecosystems, water, and resilience.
